## mourner-d17 — bearer <redacted> to Nino
> YOU PICK [ans:q_fun:a_people] 
YOU: "Nothing fancy. Just — people. Being around my people."
NPC: "Right. The free things. Turns out they were the expensive ones."

> YOU PICK [invite_party] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Esther is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About what you did for fun — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I keep turning over the last thing Esther said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
NPC: "Nobody says Esther's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
NPC: "Right. Done. Don't look so relieved."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

### FULL TRANSCRIPT
NPC: "About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday. Don't waste it."
YOU: "Nothing fancy. Just — people. Being around my people."
NPC: "Right. The free things. Turns out they were the expensive ones."
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Esther is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "About what you did for fun — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I keep turning over the last thing Esther said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "Nobody says Esther's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
NPC: "Right. Done. Don't look so relieved."
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "My part? I remember them. Someone has to do it properly."
NPC: "Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
NPC: They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

CARRY-FLAGS: mourn=true namedMourn=true packMention=false want=curious
